name: Wisecrack
tagline: Write the funniest answer. Win the room's votes.
description: Everyone gets two prompts and writes a one-liner for each. Each prompt then goes on the TV with its two answers, anonymously; everyone else votes for the funnier one. 100 points per vote, a bonus for a clean sweep, and with two or more rounds the last one counts double.
howToPlay: You get two prompts. Write a funny one-liner for each.
Each prompt goes on the TV with two answers, and nobody knows whose.
Vote for the funnier one. 100 points a vote; a clean sweep earns a bonus.
